A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PPCI and DERM research despite the changed title. All 21 pages of each version, including figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–C, support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original ISTAnt transfer experiments using newly collected ant videos and controlled CausalMNIST simulations, with results in Figure 2 and Table 1.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and adds a CausalMNIST analysis comparing downstream causal estimators in Appendix C.2 and Table 3.

M1.justification: The causal-lifting constraint, manipulated training distribution, and DERM loss weights remain unchanged: v2 Equations 7–10 correspond to v3 Equations 6–9. Additional downstream estimators are evaluated in an auxiliary analysis without revising DERM.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same collected ant experiment, ISTAnt target experiment, and five CausalMNIST distributions. The added estimator analysis retains these data and task scenarios.

E2.justification: ERM, vREx, and IRM remain the training-method comparators in Figure 2 and Table 1. New Table 3 retains ERM as the comparator to DERM and varies downstream causal estimators for both methods.

E3.justification: Appendix C.2 introduces a controlled comparison using AIPW, X-Learner, BART, and Causal Forest on the same prediction-powered samples. Existing benchmark sample sizes, training budgets, validation procedures, and metrics remain unchanged.

E4.justification: New Appendix C.2 and Table 3 test whether prediction-induced ATE bias depends on the downstream causal estimator. This supplements the retained distribution-shift analyses with an estimator-sensitivity check for ERM and DERM.

E5.justification: Both versions report 50 resampled CausalMNIST repetitions, standard deviations, bootstrapped intervals, and AIPW-based 95% ISTAnt intervals. New Table 3 follows the existing reporting practice; Table 1's added reference to data-generation repetitions restates information already in v2's appendix.

E6.justification: Table 3 adds non-AIPW results, including linear soft-shift BART biases of 0.81±0.19 for ERM and 0.07±0.14 for DERM. Section 5 corrects the ISTAnt reference effect from approximately 40 seconds to 40 half-second clips, approximately 20 seconds. Main Table 1 and Figure 2 values remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Lemma 2.2 explicitly adds double robustness, with a short justification in Appendix A.2. Appendix A.3 specifies the transfer assumption over outcome values occurring in either distribution. v2's Equation 6 formalizing treatment-appearance equivalence is removed, while the principal proof derivations remain.

C1.justification: The abstract broadens the novelty wording from first zero-shot PPCI specifically on ISTAnt to first valid causal inference on a scientific experiment with complex recordings and no human annotations. The central conditional-calibration, causal-lifting, and DERM contributions are retained.

C2.justification: v3 adds an out-of-scope qualification for recovering an unobserved adjustment set from measurements and interprets the new estimator tests as showing persistent prediction-induced bias. Appendix B.1 also changes the grooming-decline explanation from time after treatment to time after exposure to a new environment. Principal transfer limitations remain.

D1.justification: Appendix B.1 newly documents analysis at 2 fps despite recording at 30 fps. Appendix C.3 adds implementation settings for the additional estimators. Conversely, v2's explicit dataset-release statement disappears; neither PDF supplies a code or collected-dataset access location.

R1.justification: v3 adds Cadei and Internò (2025), Yao et al. (2025), and references for X-Learner, BART, and Causal Forest. It acknowledges Yao et al.'s measurement and benchmarking perspective and revises its positioning relative to earlier PPCI work. The broader related-work coverage remains.

P1.justification: The title changes to Prediction-Powered Causal Inferences, accompanied by substantial rewriting of the abstract, introduction, problem framing, related-work discussion, and conclusion. The infinite-sample example is shortened, and appendix subsections are renamed and reorganized. This constitutes a broad narrative revision despite stable core methods.

P2.justification: v3 adds the estimator-results Table 3 and moves the existing training-settings table to page 21 as Table 4. Captions and surrounding layout are revised, while all existing figure artwork is retained.

improvement.justification: Correcting the ISTAnt time units and documenting 2 fps analysis improve interpretation and reproducibility. The added estimator-sensitivity analysis provides useful support beyond AIPW. These limited gains outweigh the loss of the explicit dataset-release statement; the main results and unresolved target-domain transfer assumptions remain unchanged.
